status: Integrated in SixRoomPreview as two DungeonTorch.tscn Sprite2D instances; Godot import 256x384, uniform scale 0.48, feet at (430,454) and (662,454).
initial_prompt:
Create ONE isolated 2D game sprite of the violet wall torch in the supplied reference image. Reference role: this is the approved torch's visual design, shape, proportions, orientation, color palette and painterly game style. The wall and arch in that reference are background to remove entirely. Generate a clean new standalone rendering of that same torch, not a new torch design.

Use case: background-extraction / faithful game sprite.
The subject is a compact medieval dark blue-slate and black iron wall sconce: a wide shallow rounded bowl with a thick lavender-lit rim, a short downward tapering dark support ending in a rounded foot, and one softly curling upright magical flame with a luminous white-lilac core and violet outer edges. Keep the bowl-to-support proportions and softly beveled, thick dark outlines of the reference. Preserve the original nearly frontal view with a small visible top ellipse on the bowl, appropriate for the approved 2D top-down dungeon facade. Do not rotate, make isometric, add realism, ornaments, spikes, chains, a wooden handle or a backplate. Keep modest, readable painted detail at small game size; do not make it more intricate than the original.

Deliver exactly one complete centered torch on a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. No wall, stones, arch, floor, cast shadow, scene, text, border, watermark or painted checkerboard. Preserve smooth alpha edges and semitransparent wisps of the flame. Only a very restrained local violet fringe hugging the flame; no large ambient halo or rectangular glow since the game supplies environmental light. Keep the opaque support clearly separated from the transparent background. Entire flame tip and foot must be inside the canvas, with ample transparent padding on every side. A tall upright sprite, clean and crisp, ready to be placed as a single Sprite2D.
refinement_prompt:
Edit the standalone torch in Image 1. Image 2 is the original in-game torch and is the authority for its compact proportions and simple painted style. Output ONE torch, no other objects, on genuine transparent RGBA.

Targeted correction: remove the long thin S-shaped tongue extending far above the flame. Make the entire flame compact and rounded with a softly irregular upright tip, matching Image 2. The visible flame height ABOVE the bowl must be approximately equal to the bowl's outside width, not twice that width. Keep a bright white-lilac teardrop core and a small violet fringe. Reduce the large surrounding purple cloud to just a soft narrow semitransparent edge hugging the flame. Preserve the existing bowl and tapering short wall mount's orientation, silhouettes and dark outlines. Match the original's readable hand-painted 2D blue-slate style and modest detail, nearly frontal with a small top view of the bowl. Opaque bowl and support; soft alpha for flame fringe.

Final asset must contain only the complete compact torch, centered with transparent margins; no wall, arch, floor, backdrop, cast shadow, text, checkerboard pattern, extra ornament or large glow. Keep the background fully transparent, not black.
